sir_amik: 107 quest points and Legends' Quest started
Family Crest, Heroes, Shilo Village, Underground Pass and Waterfall Quest completed
Milk plus cream, then cornflour, vanilla, Evil Chicken egg and ground dramen cinnamon
The spare dramen branch can be cut during Lost City and ground at Lumbridge when preparing Sir Amik's dish.
Raw chicken shrine entry, instanced Evil Chicken and black dragon, token rubbed with ice gloves
Completion awards 1 quest point, 4,000 Cooking and 4,000 Hitpoints XP
Entry to Kharazi uses an axe and machete, plus Radimus notes until Legends' Quest is complete. Vanilla can be picked before inspecting Sir Amik.
Every visit to the lair consumes one normal raw chicken. Bring dragonfire protection for the approach as needed. The black dragon can be safespotted.
The safe flambé uses ice gloves and can be done in Lumbridge or Zanaris. The player can also take damage from an unprotected flambé in the game.
culinaromancer: 175 quest points, eight rescues, Desert Treasure I and Horror from the Deep
Six ordered fights with prayer disabled. You can leave through the portal between fights and restock at the Lumbridge cellar bank without losing progress.
For Karamel, stat restore potions are optional supplies. Magic users can take a fire spell with a level margin for stat drain.
The final win returns the player to Lumbridge, grants one quest point and issues a bankable 20,000 XP lamp for a skill with a base level of at least 50.

The vanilla waypoint and local walk time are approximate. The quest records a safe ice-glove flambé; verify damage and healing costs before adding an alternative without gloves.
Verify Sir Amik's staged item combinations and death recovery in game. Each modeled lair entry debits one normal raw chicken.
Both Evil Chicken and black dragon are success-dependent combat; precise inventory, antifire equipment, food and XP are not represented.
Verify food, runes, restore doses and fight duration across loadouts. The cellar bank tile and walking time are estimated.
Verify the lamp at exactly level 50 and check full-inventory handover in game. The experience item table lists minimum 50; some quest walkthroughs use wording that could imply 51.
